Once you've rebooted, you can (re)connect your FTDI
device and it will show up in /dev, usually like this:

  /dev/tty.usbserial-XXXXXXXX

where XXXXXXXX is a random ID, based on the serial number.

To uninstall the driver, you must use the GUI to move the
application from /Applications/FTDIUSBSerialDextInstaller.app to Trash,
otherwise the system extension will not be removed.

You must reboot for the installation of ftdi-vcp-driver to take effect.

izzyondroid:com.oksigenia.oksigenia_sos.name: Oksigenia SOS
izzyondroid:com.oksigenia.oksigenia_sos.summary: Smart safety and distress alerts with fall and inactivity detection.
izzyondroid:com.oksigenia.oksigenia_sos.description:
Oksigenia SOS is an offline-first personal safety app for outdoor sports and high-risk environments. No account, no cloud, no Google Services required — everything runs on your device.
 When something goes wrong, it sends an SMS alert with your GPS coordinates to your emergency contact. No internet connection needed.
 Smart Fall Detection (Smart Sentinel)
 The accelerometer monitors you continuously at high frequency. A sudden impact triggers an observation window. If sustained walking movement is detected during that window, the alarm is dismissed automatically — false positives from drops or normal jolts won't fire the SOS. If no rhythmic movement is detected, the SOS is sent.
 Activity profiles
 Pick the profile that matches what you're doing — Smart Sentinel adapts its sensitivity:
 Trekking / Hiking: balanced default for walking outdoors.
 Running (road): tuned for the sustained high-G cadence of road running, with an adaptive rhythm detector.
 Trail running / MTB: higher impact threshold for terrain with constant vibration.
 Mountaineering: longer observation window for slow recoveries on technical ground.
 Paragliding / Kayak / Watersports: automatic fall detection is disabled (the sensor cannot reliably interpret flight or water motion); inactivity monitor and manual SOS remain active.
 Professional / Rescue: extended observation window for advanced operational use.
 Inactivity Monitor (Dead Man's Switch)
 Set a check-in timer. If you don't confirm you're OK before it expires, the alert is sent automatically. Essential for solo adventures where a fall might leave you conscious but unable to call for help.
 Live Tracking
 Send your GPS position by SMS every 30, 60 or 120 minutes. Pause, resume or check in manually at any time — without stopping the monitoring session.
 Dying Gasp
 When the battery drops below 5%, a final SMS with your last GPS position is sent automatically before the phone shuts down.
 Privacy and Compatibility
 No account or registration required
 All data stays on your device — no cloud sync, no telemetry
 No trackers, no analytics, no ads
 Works on de-Googled phones (GrapheneOS, MicroG)
 Open source under GPLv3
 About the permissions
 Oksigenia SOS asks for sensitive permissions because its job is to call for help when you cannot. Each one maps to a single rescue function:
 SMS: sends the alert. SMS is the only channel that works in the mountains without internet.
 Location, including "Allow all the time" (background location): when you fall, your phone is in your pocket with the screen off and the app in the background. Without background access, Android can deny a fresh GPS fix at exactly that moment, and the SOS would leave without usable coordinates. Your position is read only when an alert or tracking update is being sent, and it travels exclusively inside the SMS to the contacts you configured — it is never uploaded anywhere. The app has no network access at all: it does not even request the INTERNET permission.
 Motion sensors / physical activity: fall and inactivity detection.
 Battery exemption: so Android doesn't kill the monitoring service mid-route.
 A safety app that prioritised permission minimalism over getting your coordinates to a rescuer would be failing at its only job. The privacy guarantee here is structural, not cosmetic: everything stays on the device.
 Available in 11 languages.
 IMPORTANT: Oksigenia SOS is a support tool and does not replace professional emergency services. Its operation depends on mobile coverage, GPS signal and battery level.

 Notes:
 This approach towards IPv6 has subtle implications on your privacy: for IPv6 connections, you have a fixed IP and you - as a person! - are easily identifyable by all IPv6 communication partners. Also, your mobile device suddenly has an IP on which it is reachable from the outside.
 This app cannot be used when another VPN is active.
 It is not required to have a rooted device.
 About license:
 You can opt for the convenience package, and install IPv6Droid right from here. It will download, install, guide you to the setup of your account details and update from time to time as new features or bugfixes are implemented.
 But I am looking for supporters! So, I'd like to promote the approach that you set up a build environment (e.g. Android Studio), download the sources (see web site) and build it by yourself. That's it. You may use the tool, modify and even redistribute the sources under the terms of the General Public License. No obligations, but in this case you have the tools, you have the sources and you have the engagement that drives me to hope that you're going to play a more active part in bringing forward this client. E.g. by submitting detailed error reports, by submitting patches, by providing better artwork, writing better documentation, designing a better user experience, ...

fdroid:app.cleartray.name: Trayzero
fdroid:app.cleartray.summary: A Getting Things Done inbox — capture, clarify, engage. On-device, no account.
fdroid:app.cleartray.description:
Trayzero brings David Allen's Getting Things Done (GTD) method to your phone. Free, open source, no ads, no account, no sign-up. Your data lives on your device. Always.
THE FIVE GTD STEPS, BUILT IN
Capture — one tap, anywhere.
A floating Capture button on every screen. Share anything from any app straight into your inbox. Voice-to-text for hands-free thoughts. A home-screen widget for the fastest possible "add to inbox."
Clarify — the killer flow.
Process Inbox runs you through your captures one at a time, card-stack style. Each card walks the full GTD decision tree: actionable? Two-minute rule? Delegate? Single step or a project? When? Where? You hit inbox-zero faster than you thought possible.
Organize — the canonical GTD lists.
Inbox, Next Actions, Projects, Waiting For, Someday/Maybe, Calendar, Reference. Plus a real Project type with outcome, next-action warning, and Active / On Hold / Someday / Done / Dropped status. Seven default @-contexts you can extend (@phone, @computer, @errands, @home, @office, @anywhere, @waiting). Areas of Responsibility for the higher altitudes.
Reflect — a Weekly Review wizard.
A seven-step review walks you through the canonical GTD pass: clear inbox, review next actions, check waiting-for, scan calendar, review someday/maybe, look at projects, set next week's intentions. Daily review supported too.
Engage — do now.
The Engage tab filters Next Actions by Context, Energy (low / medium / high), and Time Available (<5m / <15m / <30m / <1h). Pull up the actions that match the moment you're in.
REMINDERS THAT ACTUALLY WORK
Due-date, defer-until, waiting-for follow-up, and weekly-review nudges fire as system notifications with action buttons — Done, Snooze, Move to Next Actions. Reminders survive reboots and app updates. Opt-in two-way calendar sync mirrors dated items into your system calendar.
VOICE, PHOTOS, AUDIO
Capture by voice. Attach photos or voice memos to any item.
PRIVACY YOU DON'T HAVE TO THINK ABOUT
- 100% on-device. SQLite under the hood.
- No account, no servers, no analytics.
- Crash reporting is opt-in and off by default.
- Backup/restore as plain JSON: you own your data, you can take it anywhere.
MATERIAL 3, LIGHT + DARK
A sunrise-amber palette, slidable rows, accessibility-friendly text scaling and TalkBack labels.
WHO IT'S FOR
- GTD practitioners who want a clean, focused app that respects the method.
- Anyone tired of cloud-syncing personal task data through someone else's servers.
- People who want their tasks where their phone is — and nowhere else.
Trayzero is an independent app inspired by the Getting Things Done methodology. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by David Allen Company. "Getting Things Done" and "GTD" are trademarks of the David Allen Company.

fdroid:com.flyboybyte.dragtree.name: DragTree
fdroid:com.flyboybyte.dragtree.summary: NHRA Pro Tree reaction game — sensor launch, 2 Player, fully offline
fdroid:com.flyboybyte.dragtree.description:
DragTree is a reaction-time game built on a real NHRA Christmas Tree (the drag strip starting lights). Watch the ambers, react to the green, and see how fast you were. Beat your best, or beat a friend.
Launch it however you like:
• Motion sensor — mount the phone in the car, stage, and drive off. The app detects the launch and times it from the start of acceleration. No tapping.
• Tap — a big on-screen button.
• Hold to Launch — hold the button through the tree and let go on green, like a trans-brake button.
• Volume buttons and remotes — use a volume button, a wired headphone button, or a cheap Bluetooth camera-shutter remote as your launch button (Settings, off by default).
Fully offline — no internet, no account, no ads, no tracking.
TWO PLAYER
Put the phone between two people. Each gets their own lane and light; best reaction wins, and a red light loses.
TREES
• Pro Tree (.400) — all three ambers together, green 0.400 s later
• Sportsman Tree (.500) — ambers count down one at a time, green 0.500 s after the last
GRADES
Perfect (under .050) · Pro · Great · Good · Late · Red Light, which shows how early you went.
TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
• History of your last 30 runs, personal best, and a trend chart
• Consistency stats: average, spread, how often you land within ±.020, and your streak
• Series mode: 3, 5 or 10 runs back to back with a summary
• Time-slip comparison: enter the reaction time from a real slip and see how your phone differs
BUILT FOR PRECISION
• The motion sensor is read up to 200 times a second with the sensor's own timestamps, on phones with or without a gyroscope
• Accelerometer test: records 5 seconds of background vibration and suggests the most sensitive setting it won't trip
• Phone latency check: screen rate, sensor rate and a tap test, so you know how much of a time is the phone
• Three sensitivity presets plus a custom setting
Optional sounds: a tick on each amber, a beep at green and a chime for your result.
The reaction time shown is how quickly you responded after the green. A track time slip also includes the car's rollout and drivetrain response, so DragTree is best for practice and consistency, not for predicting your exact slip.
PERMISSIONS
• HIGH_SAMPLING_RATE_SENSORS — fast motion-sensor readings
• VIBRATE — touch feedback
• MODIFY_AUDIO_SETTINGS — plays the sound effects
There is no internet permission at all, and no microphone, location or storage access.

fdroid:com.rousecontext.name: Rouse Context
fdroid:com.rousecontext.summary: Turn your phone into a secure, on-demand MCP server for AI clients
fdroid:com.rousecontext.description:
Rouse Context turns your Android phone into an on-demand MCP (Model Context Protocol) server. An AI client connects to a URL, your phone wakes up, and a direct encrypted session is established. The client asks for what it needs — health data, notifications, app usage — your phone answers, then goes back to sleep.
 Your data stays on the device. The session runs end-to-end encrypted between the AI client and your phone; the relay that connects them only forwards that encrypted traffic and can't read it.
 Wake-ups use UnifiedPush , so install a UnifiedPush distributor (for example ntfy) to be reached while the app is in the background.
 Features:
 On-demand — your phone is only reachable while a client is connected, then sleeps again. No always-on background service draining the battery.
 You stay in control — you enable each integration explicitly, and every tool call an AI client makes is recorded in an on-device audit history you can review.
 Private by design — data never leaves the device except through a live, user-approved session.
 Certificate monitoring — the app checks public transparency logs (crt.sh, or Certspotter as backup) for certificates issued to your device's address, so a forged one doesn't go unnoticed. Runs every 12 hours by default; change the interval or turn it off in Settings.
 Free and open source, with no analytics or tracking in the app.

Every level is a pixel art masterpiece. Your ants will devour it - one color at a time.
Food Hunt is a satisfying color sort puzzle where the puzzle board IS the art. Each level presents a hand-crafted pixel art image built entirely from colored blocks. Sort your ants by color, send them in, and watch them eat the picture clean - block by block, until the board is empty and the level is cleared.
HOW TO PLAY
The board is filled with a pixel art image - built entirely from colored blocks. Below the board: your holding slots and block stacks waiting to be tapped.
Tap a block stack to load your ants. They march up and devour every matching colored block in the image. Clear all colors - wipe the board completely - and you win.
But choose your order carefully:
- Holding slots are limited - wrong tap order fills them fast
- Stuck slots = ants can't move = game over
- Plan which color to clear first
- Eat every last block - board empty - level clear!
THE PIXEL ART IS THE PUZZLE
Forget collecting rewards after you win. In Food Hunt, the pixel art image is the challenge itself.
Every level is a different image, built from hundreds of colored blocks. Watch your ants devour it layer by layer, color by color, until nothing remains.
You don't unlock the art. You clear it. And that's exactly what makes it satisfying.
FEATURES
- 200+ color sort puzzle levels - new images, new challenges
- Cute ants with ASMR-quality chomping animations
- Simple one-tap controls - play with one hand
- No timer, no pressure - relax at your own pace
- Levels designed to surprise - no two boards look the same
- 2× speed mode for snappier ant action
EASY TO LEARN. HARD TO STOP.
Early levels are breezy. Later levels pack in more colors, tighter slots, and bigger images that demand real planning.
Which color do you clear first? When do you free a slot before it jams? Every tap matters.
A true logic brain teaser - wrapped in pixel art you'll actually enjoy destroying.
WHY YOU CHOOSE FOOD HUNT?
Most color sort games show you an empty grid and ask you to fill it. Food Hunt flips it - every board starts full, alive with pixel art, and your only goal is to wipe it clean.
Same satisfying sort. A completely different feeling. 
Download Food Hunt - the color sort puzzle where the art is the game.

flathub:com.axantum.xecrets.ez.name: Xecrets Ez
flathub:com.axantum.xecrets.ez.description:
Xecrets Ez is a true zero-knowledge desktop file and text encryption application that uses strong
 AES-256 encryption to password protect your files. Encrypted files use the .axx extension and remain
 protected wherever they go — cloud storage, email, USB drives or backups — because the encryption
 always follows the file. No data or passwords will ever leave your device.
 Unlike container-based or folder-based encryption solutions, Xecrets Ez encrypts files individually
 so protection is never lost when a file is moved or copied. It works entirely offline: no internet
 connection, no servers, no accounts required.
 Features include (some require Premium):
 AES-256 encryption
 Encrypt and decrypt individual files or all files in folders
 Encrypt text messages directly in the application
 Open and edit encrypted files with automatic re-encryption
 YubiKey hardware security key support
 SLIP-39 Shamir's Secret Sharing for password backup
 Available in English, Français, Deutsch, Italiano, Español, Português and Svenska
 No internet connection is ever used
 100% compatible with AxCrypt
 Cross-platform: Linux, Windows and macOS
 It is entirely free for encryption and decryption of files, with full security. Premium features
 require a low-cost subscription with a 10-day free trial. A 3-day premium trial is also available
 without a credit card.

fedora-packages:boxes/boxes.name: boxes
fedora-packages:boxes/boxes.description: Boxes is a command line program which draws, removes, and repairs ASCII art boxes. It operates as a text filter. The generated boxes may even be removed and repaired again if they were badly damaged by editing of the text inside. Since boxes may be open on any side, boxes can also be used to create (regional) comments in any programming language. Boxes is useful for making the function headers in your programming language look better, for spicing up news postings and emails, or just for decorating documentation files. Since the drawn box is matched in size to your input text, you can use boxes in scripts to dynamically add boxes around stuff.

Limited support for copying content of data CD and DVD discs to image files is also provided. cdw can verify correctness of writing ISO9660 image to CD or DVD disc using md5sum or some of programs that verifies SHA hashes.

fedora-packages:credcheck/credcheck.name: credcheck
fedora-packages:credcheck/credcheck.description: The credcheck PostgreSQL extension provides few general credential checks, which will be evaluated during the user creation, during the password change and user renaming. By using this extension, we can define a set of rules: allow a specific set of credentials reject a certain type of credentials deny password that can be easily cracked enforce use of an expiration date with a minimum of day for a password define a password reuse policy define the number of authentication failure allowed before a user is banned This extension provides all the checks as configurable parameters. The default configuration settings, will not enforce any complex checks and will try to allow most of the credentials. By using SET credcheck.<check-name> TO <some value>; command, enforce new settings for the credential checks. The settings can only be changed by a superuser.

fedora-packages:gfs-decker-fonts/gfs-dec.summary: GFS Decker, a 19th century Greek font family
fedora-packages:gfs-decker-fonts/gfs-dec.description: This typeface is a product of Deckersche Schriftgießere type foundry owned by Rudolf Ludwig Decker (1804-1877) in Berlin, but it was frequently used in Greek editions by both Oxford and Cambridge University Press during the last decades of the 19th century. It was designed and cut before 1864, according to John Bowman, when a set of matrices was bought by OUP, although the type was not cast and used in England until 1882. The typeface is an uncial design containing a case of capitals, and small capitals, too. The letters lack any serifs although they retain their thick and thin strokes. It appeared as an alternate type of Byzantine tradition in mostly Patristic texts. The font was digitally designed by George D. Matthiopoulos and is freely available by GFS.

fedora-packages:ghc-fmt/ghc-fmt.name: ghc-fmt
fedora-packages:ghc-fmt/ghc-fmt.description: A new formatting library that tries to be simple to understand while still being powerful and providing more convenience features than other libraries (like functions for pretty-printing maps and lists, or a function for printing arbitrary datatypes using generics). A comparison with other libraries: * 'printf' (from 'Text.Printf') takes a formatting string and uses some type tricks to accept the rest of the arguments polyvariadically. It's very concise, but there are some drawbacks – it can't produce 'Text' (you'd have to 'T.pack' it every time) and it doesn't warn you at compile-time if you pass wrong arguments or not enough of them. * <https://hackage.haskell.org/package/text-format text-format> takes a formatting string with curly braces denoting places where arguments would be substituted (the arguments themselves are provided via a tuple). If you want to apply formatting to some of the arguments, you have to use one of the provided formatters. Like 'printf', it can fail at runtime, but at least the formatters are first-class (and you can add new ones). * <https://hackage.haskell.org/package/formatting formatting> takes a formatting template consisting of pieces of strings interleaved with formatters; this ensures that arguments always match their placeholders. 'formatting' provides lots of formatters and generally seems to be the most popular formatting library here. Unfortunately, at least in my experience writing new formatters can be awkward and people sometimes have troubles understanding how 'formatting' works. * <https://hackage.haskell.org/package/fmt fmt> (i.e. this library) provides formatters that are ordinary functions, and a bunch of operators for concatenating formatted strings; those operators also do automatic conversion. There are some convenience formatters which aren't present in 'formatting' (like ones for formatting maps, lists, converting to base64, etc). Some find the operator syntax annoying, while others like it.

firefox-addons:2799161.name: Website Image Downloader
firefox-addons:2799161.summary: Download images from any website with ease. Supports single and bulk downloads, image filtering, sorting, and lazy-loaded images.
firefox-addons:2799161.description:
Image Downloader is a browser extension that helps you collect and download images from any website. You can download single or multiple images quickly and easily.
To start collecting and downloading after the extension has been installed:
(1) Visit a website.
(2) Click the extension icon in the top-right corner of your browser.
▣ Extension Features:
● Auto Collect
If enabled, the extension will automatically collect all newly loaded images. If disabled, you need to click the button manually. This is useful for websites that load images dynamically (e.g., Instagram, Pinterest, Facebook).
● Collect in Viewport
If enabled, only images currently visible in your browser window will be collected. If disabled, all images loaded on the page will be collected.
● Download Multiple Images
Download multiple selected images with one click. All files will be saved in your computer.
● Organize subfolders using variables
Images will be saved in the Downloads folder on your computer. You can organize them into subfolders using variables. for example: if an image collected from instagram.com , the image will be saved into the instagram.com subfolder in the Downloads folders.
● Add to Favorites
Save the image's URL for later downloader.
● Sort & Filter
Filter by size, width, height, or orientation (Landscape, Portrait, Square). Sort by size (width × height). View larger or smaller first. More filter & sorting options will be added in future updates.
● Adjust Image Display
Change image size: See more images at once or view them in detail.
● Background Color
Choose dark, light, or transparent backgrounds for non-square images.

When you view a paywalled scholarly article, Unpaywall automatically checks its open database of 16 million legal, open-access articles. If there's an open version somewhere, you'll see a green tab on the article. Click the tab and read for free, legally!

The tool helps visualize Carbon's 2x grid over any live page, and provides basic insights into the usage of components and patterns on a given page to help users understand how the Carbon Design System is being used.

firefox-addons:353526.name: Tab notifier
firefox-addons:353526.summary: Enables desktop notifications like in Chrome (e.g. Gmail, imo.im) and, if the site doesn't support them, it can notify new messages or updates detecting changes of the title (e.g. Hotmail, Yahoo, Facebook, Twitter). Even if the browser is minimized!
firefox-addons:353526.description:
Tab Notifier 3 was developed from scratch as a WebExtension. Screenshots and following details refer to Tab Notifier 2.x (running only on Gecko 44 or older versions for Windows and Linux), but they will be soon updated. 
Watch the demo on YouTube 
The version 2 adds a major feature: it exposes the chrome desktop notifications API to web pages and other add-ons (try it with gmail and imo!)
The extension can also show a desktop notification when the title of a tab changes while the tab is not focused.
A desktop notification it's an alert that appears outside the browser window, in a corner of your screen. Click on it to open the tab that triggered it. Besides chat, email and social networks, it works with tons of other websites, like microblogging sites and similar (e.g.: Twitter and Digg), or to show the title of a track when it starts to be played (e.g.: MySpace) .
 Also available for Chrome 
 Advanced configuration ( about:config ) 
Here are some parameters that usually don't need to be changed, so they are not showed in the preferences window:
 alerts.disableSlidingEffect can be used to disable animations (sometimes useful if you use a remote desktop over internet)
 extensions.tabnotifier.minSlideIncrementTime can be decreased to try to obtain a smoother animation, but if some notification windows hang you should increase it (new in ver. 1.3)
 extensions.tabnotifier.maxQueuedNotifications is the maximum number of notifications that are queued after the number of windows reaches maxVisibleNotifications , extra messages will be discarded (new in ver. 1.3)

bluejetty:00035564:android.description:
ScanWallet - Fast QR & Barcode Scanner, Generate Social Media QR Codes 📱✨
ScanWallet is your ultimate QR code and barcode scanner app, designed for speed, simplicity, and security. Instantly scan any QR code or barcode with your phone—perfect for shopping 🛒, organizing 📑, sharing 🤝, and accessing information wherever you go!
Key Features:
- Ultra-Fast Scanning 🚀: Scan all types of QR codes and barcodes in a flash—no waiting!
- Scan History 📂: Automatically save all your scans for easy access and management.
- Wide Format Support 🏷️: Scan product barcodes, payment codes, URLs, business cards, Wi-Fi codes, and more.
- Generate QR Codes 🔗: Easily create your own QR codes for links, contacts, Wi-Fi, and popular social media (like Facebook, Instagram, etc.).
- Smart Content Recognition 🤖: Instantly detect links, text, phone numbers, emails, and more.
- Privacy & Security 🔒: Your scan history stays private—data is stored safely on your device.
- Ad-Free & Clean Experience 🌟: Focus on what matters, with a simple, clutter-free interface.
How ScanWallet Helps You:
- Smarter Shopping 🛒: Scan product barcodes for details and price comparisons.
- Easy Sharing 🤝: Create and share QR codes for links, Wi-Fi passwords, contacts, and more in seconds.
- Stay Organized 📑: Access your scan history anytime, export or share with a tap.
- Perfect for Work & Events 🎫: Scan tickets, business cards, coupons—anything you need!
Why Choose ScanWallet?
- Lightning-Fast Scanning ⚡️ with top-notch accuracy for a seamless experience.
- Supports nearly all QR and barcode types to meet every need.
- Privacy First 🔐—your scan history stays private, and we don’t collect your data.
- User-friendly—easy for anyone to use, no learning curve!
- Regular updates and improvements based on your feedback 💬.
How to Use:
1. Open ScanWallet and point your camera at any QR code or barcode.
2. Instantly view and interact with the scanned content—open links, copy text, or save information.
3. Manage your scan history and export or share as needed.
4. Use the built-in QR generator to create codes for sharing links, Wi-Fi, and more.
Perfect For:
- Shopping 🛍️ & Price Comparison 💸
- Event Entry 🎟️ & Ticket Validation ✅
- Sharing Contact Info 📇 & Wi-Fi Access 📶
- Managing Coupons, Vouchers, and More 🎉
Download ScanWallet now and experience the fastest, easiest, and most secure way to scan, save, and create QR codes and barcodes! 🚀🔒
Have feedback or questions? Reach out via the in-app feedback feature—we love hearing from you! 💬
Scan smarter, live easier—get ScanWallet today! 🌟

bluejetty:00026984:ios.summary: FishTrack provides saltwater anglers with everything they need to find fish. The FishTrack app offers Cloud-free Sea Surface Temperature (SST) charts, high-definition global satellite imagery, including water temperature charts, water color
bluejetty:00026984:ios.description:
FishTrack provides saltwater anglers with everything they need to find fish. The FishTrack app offers Cloud-free Sea Surface Temperature (SST) charts, high-definition global satellite imagery, including water temperature charts, water color, currents, tides, moon phase and marine weather forecasts – all in one layered tool. Users can mark ‘hot spots’ and record GPS locations of temperature breaks and color barriers. Save imagery and overlay data for offline use to identify bite zones while navigating offshore.
With FishTrack you can:
-View the Latest SST and Chlorophyll imagery
-Mark, name and save data of potential hot spots
-Save fishing chart imagery for offline use
-Plot waypoints and calculate distances
-Overlay bathymetry, ocean currents and sea surface height
-View marine weather forecasts
-View your current location while offline
Don't fish blind. Save time and fuel with the FishTrack app. Download now to get started!
We want to hear from you! Submit your questions or comments through our app to let us know what you think. If you'd like to speak directly with our customer service team, please e-mail us at: support@fishtrack.com.

• Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable

bluejetty:00025752:android.name: Watcher of Realms
bluejetty:00025752:android.summary: Embark on an unparalleled Next-Gen Fantasy RPG adventure with Watcher of Realms. Journey to the continent of Tya, where heroes and monsters coexist, to collect over 250 heroes from 10 different factions. Strengthen and build out your own de
bluejetty:00025752:android.description:
Embark on an unparalleled Next-Gen Fantasy RPG adventure with Watcher of Realms. Journey to the continent of Tya, where heroes and monsters coexist, to collect over 250 heroes from 10 different factions. Strengthen and build out your own dedicated lineup, power through a vast array of levels and stages, and leave behind your own legacy along the way.
Enjoy some of your favorite RPG elements in Watcher of Realms!
1. Experience 250+ heroes to collect and upgrade! 
Unlock over 250 heroes from 10 factions and build a powerful team to stand against monsters and demons. From death knights of the abyss and noble paladins to enigmatic mages and bloodthirsty orcs—every fantasy hero you can imagine is here.
You'll also find rare Lord Heroes with exclusive Lord Skills. Collect these to buff the entire faction!
2. More exciting BOSS battles.
Epic Dragons, Mighty Golems, The Undying Bull, The Lord of Styx, The Conquerer, and many Bosses are ready to throw down the gauntlet! Take on these formidable foes in Guild Boss, Void Rift, Immortal Codex and other modes to claim your stake of Tya's finest treasure.
3. Refreshingly diverse RPG elements.
Obtain rare resources from dungeon levels where gruesome monsters await. Strengthen and improve your hero’s attributes by collecting gear, artifacts, and legendary skill dust to get the edge.
Reinforce your camp and explore multiple game modes while leading your heroes to ultimate victory on the grandest battlefield of all.
4. User friendly and deeply strategic gameplay. 
The diverse continent of Tya includes vast deserts, chilling dungeons, colossal mountains and more. With each stage posing new challenges, commanders must choose the best faction and hero combinations to survive. Charge into battle with your fearless heroes and activate their ultimate skills, AOE/magic damage, and healing spells with precision timing to defend your position!
5. High-quality audio-visual effects. Incredibly immersive.
Realistically magical 3D models of heroes fleshed with exquisite details. Top-tier motion and facial capture technologies make your heroes incredibly vivid and lifelike.
With premium CG and character designs in 360°, players will fall in love with customized animations which bring each hero to life.
6. Massive multiplayer PvP battles.
Original tower defense PvP mode will showcase your skills. With multiple PvP themes, you can climb player rankings and fight your way straight to the top!
7. Grand worldview, rich storylines.
Explore a range of chapters, maps, and levels. Epic faction and hero lore will provide you an immersive experience into the world of Tya’s magic. Each hero has a unique backstory waiting for you to discover!
Please Note:
*Watcher of Realms supports English, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Indonesian, and Russian. We understand that RPGs are always more immersive to players in their native languages, so we are working hard on adding more languages to the game!
Official Website: https://www.watcherofrealms.com/
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/WatcherofRealms/
Discord: https://discord.gg/Vn8UpGF
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@WatcherofRealmsOfficial
Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/WatcherofRealmsGame/

bluejetty:00015760:ios.description:
Math & English Help That Actually Works
We teach four subjects: Math, English, Science and Social Studies. 5,000+ step-by-step video lessons run from Kindergarten through college, and test-prep courses for the SAT, GED, ASVAB, AP, ACT and ACCUPLACER are in the catalog.
HOW A SESSION RUNS
• Pick 7th Grade Math and the topics arrive in the order the course teaches them
• Each lesson teaches the method, then works through an example
• Practice adjusts to your child's level, with the full solution after every question
• They can retake a quiz until the score says the topic is solid
• Continue Learning opens the next topic, never one already finished
• Study Points and a daily streak keep the habit going
• When they are stuck mid-question, Photo Search finds the lesson that covers it
WHAT YOU GET AS THE PARENT
• Each child gets their own profile and their own progress
• A study plan on each course they open, in the order your state's standards set out
• Topic scores that are current the moment you open the app
• Homeschool families set the pace; nothing is marked late
WHAT IS COVERED
On video: Math from Kindergarten to college. English and Social Studies to Grade 7. Science to Grade 7, plus senior Physics and Chemistry (including Organic Chemistry).
Questions and quizzes: all four subjects, Kindergarten to Grade 12
Test prep in the catalog: SAT Math, GED Mathematics, ASVAB Math Knowledge, AP Calculus AB/BC, AP Statistics, ACT Math, ACCUPLACER
2.1+ MILLION U.S. STUDENTS USE STUDYPUG
• 50,000+ practice problems with worked solutions
• Courses aligned to your state standards, so the next topic follows the one their class just finished
WHAT IT COSTS
Plans start at $14.99 a month. Cancel any time.
StudyPug is a subscription service. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage subscriptions in your account settings.

bluejetty:00025606:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00025606:ios.description:
Blocky Quest – A real blockbuster!
► New kid on the block 
If you’re a fan of block puzzles, then welcome to a brand-new block puzzle game offering a unique and refreshing twist on the classic gameplay and format. Download Blocky Quest now and dive into an awesome, never-ending block party of a game!
The features block:
◾ A chip off the old block: Packed with features and beautifully designed, Blocky Quest takes a legend and runs with it, providing a rewarding and addictive puzzle experience for players young and old, bricks game is fanatics and all fans of challenging and dynamic brainteasers.
◾ The blocks don’t drop: Unlike in traditional building block games, in Blocky Quest you don’t have to fit the blocks on the board as they fall. In fact, you’ve got all the time in the world to try to find the best position. This makes the game more like a jigsaw puzzle, but it doesn’t make it any less fun or infuriating.
◾ The twist is… There’s no twisting! In contrast with other brick games, you can’t turn the blocks around here, you have to work out how to fit them together along the axis they appear. Unless you’re ready to use boosters, that is…
◾ Feeling blocked? Blocky Quest features a range of boosters to help you out of tough spots in puzzles. Earn up to five different types of boosters as you play, then use them to twist, blast, sweep or slam your way past whatever’s blocking your next move.
◾ Feeling adventurous? Alongside classic gameplay, where you can keep slotting the blocks into place endlessly to carry on surviving and achieve a new high score, there are also quests, where levels have specific goals and winning multiple levels brings you chests with extra rewards.
◾ On a quest: Can you match all the blocks with the right gems to reach the target? Or will you be able to puzzle out the mess on the board at the start of the level and get the necessary score? If not, you’ll just have to try again to pass the brick game levels and complete the quest. The rewards are worth it!
► On a quest for a great puzzle game?
Looking for a new take on classic games with fun new features, addictive gameplay, and stylish packaging? Blocky Quest is guaranteed to rock your block, combining tried and tested puzzle features from much-loved old games with genuinely original and engaging new mechanics that will test your puzzle brain and your spatial awareness, while also providing a relaxing and absorbing gameplay environment to soothe stress and help you relax whenever you have a spare five minutes. Install Blocky Quest now and get ready to set out on a real puzzle adventure!
Privacy Policy: https://say.games/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://say.games/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00016378:ios.description:
What would your life be without modern technology on the deserted island? Dive into simplicity of the primal world with the modern Stone Age family in this thrilling offline adventure game. Stranded on the remote island, a family of four - Bruce, Eva and their kids - needs your guidance and help starting a new family home from scratch and navigating through various family life situations with humour. 
After their previous city had been destroyed by a volcanic eruption, help this family build a thriving town, all while looking for a way to reconnect with their family and beloved tribe. In this farm game, their world might seem ancient and alien without modern day technology, yet their daily family life and relationships are very relatable in today’s world.
Family Island™ is a farm game full of unexpected twists and captivating adventure! 
FEATURES:
- Enjoy your adventure to the Stone Age era! Get creative and start farming, using cool ancient technologies 
- In this farm game, you can unleash your inner explorer and set on a thrilling adventure to new islands 
- Start your own family farm on the deserted island! Grow crops and craft useful goods to trade with other characters
- Customize your farm with beautiful decorations
- Get to know the family better and guide them through exciting quests and life stories in this island game
 ____________ 
Follow Family Island on Facebook and Instagram for exclusive offers and bonuses!

Questions about the game? Our support is ready and waiting at: https://melsoft-games.helpshift.com/hc/en/11-family-island/

listings.name: Family Island — Farming game
listings.description:
What would your life be without modern technology on the deserted island? Dive into simplicity of the primal world with the modern Stone Age family in this thrilling offline adventure game. Stranded on the remote island, a family of four - Bruce, Eva and their kids - needs your guidance and help starting a new family home from scratch and navigating through various family life situations with humour. 

After their previous city had been destroyed by a volcanic eruption, help this family build a thriving town, all while looking for a way to reconnect with their family and beloved tribe. In this farm game, their world might seem ancient and alien without modern day technology, yet their daily family life and relationships are very relatable in today’s world.

Family Island™ is a farm game full of unexpected twists and captivating adventure! 

FEATURES:
- Enjoy your adventure to the Stone Age era! Get creative and start farming, using cool ancient technologies 
- In this farm game, you can unleash your inner explorer and set on a thrilling adventure to new islands 
- Start your own family farm on the deserted island! Grow crops and craft useful goods to trade with other characters
- Customize your farm with beautiful decorations
- Get to know the family better and guide them through exciting quests and life stories in this island game

 ____________ 

Follow Family Island on Facebook and Instagram for exclusive offers and bonuses!
Facebook: facebook.com/familyislandgame/
Instagram: instagram.com/familyislandgame/


Terms of Service: https://static.moonactive.net/legal/terms.html?lang=en
Privacy Notice: https://static.moonactive.net/legal/privacy.html?lang=en
The game contains in-game purchases (including randomized items)

Questions about the game? Our support is ready and waiting at:  https://melsoft-games.helpshift.com/hc/en/11-family-island/

IGRS rating 13+

Experience the swiftest and safest OCR capture for receipts, bills, and invoices with Veryfi's powerful data extraction app. Bid farewell to manual entry and bookkeeping, saving hours weekly.
Veryfi swiftly extracts vendor details, payment information, totals, taxes, and line items. Achieve efficiency with SOC2 Type2 certification, CCPA, HIPAA, and GDPR compliance.

- Recognizing vendors from logos through ML
- Extracting transaction details, including handwritten totals and tips
- Identifying date, time, payment type, and currency with automatic conversion
- Categorizing receipts based on regional accounting codes
- Offering rich OCR text with line items and invoice details
Explore the world's first machine-powered line-by-line item extraction from receipts, including hotel bills.

- 90% time savings in record-chasing and data entry

- A secure vault for business tax, bookkeeping, and project documents

For teams, gain field intelligence by adding your team to Veryfi for real-time data insights on time and material purchases.
Secure your data with Veryfi Shield, ensuring CCPA, HIPAA, and GDPR compliance with encrypted data at rest and in transit.
Veryfi, dedicated to automating bookkeeping, especially for AEC industries, offers smart tools to eliminate data entry, enhance job costing, and boost financial prosperity without the constraints of legacy technology.

bluejetty:00024185:ios.description:
Love Photo Frames Collage is an app to create personalized love photo collages by adding your own photos.
You can use a great variety of frames for love photos, with which you can create some beautiful designs and love collages to tell a beloved person how much you love him or her.
How to use the app “Love Photo Frames Collage ”
We have developed a complete love photo collage maker for you, with which you can decorate love photos and give them your personal touch:
1.- The first step is to choose the kind of love collage photo frame you would like to use. For your convenience, we have divided the available frames into different categories, so that you can design the best personalised photo frame collage for every occasion: frames with hearts, love frames with animals, valentine day photo frames, flower photo frames, rose photo frames, wedding photo frames, couple photo frames, anniversary photo frames, romantic photo frames, etc.
2.- Once you have chosen the frame category you would like to use, you can browse through the different love frames for photos you can find in that section.
3.- Once you have selected the frame you like, you will have to add your photo to the love collage you will design. You can use the photo gallery of your mobile device or the camera to take a photo at that moment. Remember that you can move, rotate or resize the image you would like to add so that your photos perfectly fit in into any of the love collage frames you can find in the app.
4.- In the last 2 steps you can add personalized texts to your add the text you like (and say “I love you”, “Happy anniversary” or whatever you like). Additionally, you can add love photos or stickers/badges to give your love collage a personalized finishing touch.

Get ready to catch sneaky cheaters, break up fights, handle the pop quiz, and get your students through tricky tests, all
bluejetty:00024827:ios.description:
Ready to step into the classroom and rule your school? In this exciting teacher game, YOU are the star of the show! 
Get ready to catch sneaky cheaters, break up fights, handle the pop quiz, and get your students through tricky tests, all while you try to keep your cool under pressure. 
It’s time to see if you’ve got what it takes to be a greatest teacher, or the one evil teacher that everyone dreads!
Take charge of your class, from marking papers to crafting lessons that actually make learning fun. 
You’ll have to manage behaviour and discipline rowdy students, stop the bullies, and be a mentor who inspires, all while you take control of the chaos of school life. 
Every decision you make has a ripple effect, will you be the school teacher everyone loves, or the one they try to avoid at all costs?
Game Features:
- Catch cheaters red-handed and send them to the principal (nobody’s getting away with it!).
- Handle pop quizzes and tricky exams, your students will either shine or… not.
- Grade papers with care and precision, and watch your students’ results unfold.
- Break up fights, stop the bullies, and manage your classroom like a pro.
- Build your teaching style - make choices; Will you be the kind educator or the mean teacher who rules with an iron fist?
- Daily rewards keep you motivated as you master the art of teaching (or perhaps, surviving school chaos!).
Navigate school life in all its glory, there’s never a dull moment! Marking papers to disciplining students every day in the classroom is a new adventure. 
Will you achieve the “Best Teacher” award, or the one everyone whispers about in the corridors?
The choice is yours: conquer the classroom or tackle the chaos. Test your brain, sharpen your pencils, and prepare for a wild ride!
SUBSCRIBE TO TEACHER SIMULATOR
Subscribe to Teacher Simulator for all of the following benefits:
* New 'Arts & Crafts’’ Mini Game
* VIP Outfit
* No Ads
* x2 Earnings
SUBSCRIPTIONS INFORMATION:
Teacher Simulator VIP Membership access offers two membership options:
1) A weekly subscription costing $5.49 per week after a 3 day FREE trial period.
2) A monthly subscription costing $14.49 per month.
After buying this subscription, you will unlock an exclusive ‘Arts & Crafts’ Mini Game to play, a VIP outfit to wear, remove non-optional ads, and x2 earning from your clients. Ace Your HR Certification Exams with HR Cards: The Ultimate Prep Tool for SHRM and HRCI!
Preparing for the PHR, SPHR, SHRM-CP, or SHRM-SCP exams? HR Cards helps you master over 1300 HR-specific terms in just 5 minutes a day! Whether you’re studying for HRCI or SHRM certifications, HR Cards gives you the edge with critical vocabulary and hundreds of test questions, all designed to boost your confidence and get you exam-ready.
Why choose HR Cards?
1300+ key HR terms in 9 easy-to-navigate, color-coded categories 
Comprehensive test questions to practice and refine your knowledge 
Track your progress by category to see where you excel and what needs work 
Interactive flashcards for a personalized study experience: shuffle, restart, or focus on challenging terms 
Expert insights from Lori Kleiman, SPHR, SHRM-SCP, with 20+ years of certification prep experience
With HR Cards, you’re not just studying; you’re preparing to succeed!

App Features:
Guess the word or definition and reinforce your learning
Shuffle and reset for continuous practice
Progress tracker shows your improvement over time
Flashcard methodology, proven to enhance memory and retention
Start with a FREE 3-day trial! For just $4.99 for 6 months, unlock full access, including regular updates with new terms, trends, and emerging HR acronyms to stay current in your field.
HR Cards is your fast track to HR success!
Perfect for HR professionals looking to **advance their U.S.-based HR careers**, or students aiming to **ace their HR coursework**.
---
Why This App Works:
Flashcards are a time-tested method for enhancing memory and retention. With HR Cards, you’ll see terms until you know them by heart, making it easier to select the correct answers on exam day. Plus, the app’s interactive design with specific feedback for you helps you focus on areas that need more attention.
---
Created by a Leading HR Expert
Lori Kleiman, SPHR, SHRM-SCP, has been teaching HR certification prep courses for over 20 years. She’s taken all her knowledge and packed it into this app to give you the tools you need to succeed. With Lori’s proven methodology, HR Cards is your key to mastering the terms and concepts essential for passing your exam.
How does HR Cards work? 
1. You Select a category to get started; all the major HR categories are included plus acronyms
2. Tap a word to reveal its definition 
3. Indicate whether you got the word right or need to try again 
4. Track your progress with the bar chart for each knowledge area 
5. **Toggle** between viewing words first or definitions for an added challenge

- Choose the animals you want to combine with each other.
- Use AI technology to transform and mix them together.
- Enjoy your own achievements and save those monsters to your collection.

- Experience fast cutting edge AI technology in minutes.
- Answer questions about combinations of animals.
- Countless animals with the number up to more than 300 and constantly updated.
- Design your own unique creature collection.

bluejetty:00027420:ios.summary:
In this casual yet realistic life sim with a Chinese authenticity, you step into the shoes of an average kid from the first day of life towards the end of your high school days.
Study hard, have fun, make friends and face the “Gaokao”, one
bluejetty:00027420:ios.description:
In this casual yet realistic life sim with a Chinese authenticity, you step into the shoes of an average kid from the first day of life towards the end of your high school days.
Study hard, have fun, make friends and face the “Gaokao”, one of the most critical examinations in your life. And perhaps this experience might also give you a special perspective to explore your relationships as a parent and as a child.
[Game Features]
- A unique slice of life simulator
You are a child born in an ordinary Chinese family. Prior to Gaokao, one of the most critical examinations, you have 18 years to enjoy your life and make choices to be yourself.
- Be a Chinese kid
As a girl or a boy, different experiences from heartfully weaved stories and distinctive characters awaits you.
- Use “Fragments” to improve yourself
Raise your stats with Fragment mini-game. Higher stats improve your character through learning new skills.
- Tiger Parent, or not?
Scheduling every detail, either ensure a happy and stress-free life, or force the kid to study as hard as possible? It’s all up to you.
- Live the life as a Chinese child with various mini-games
Expect a life full of challenges. Do you have what it takes to defeat your annoying and cocky neighbors in the Face Duel? Or can you maintain your cool while trying everything to grasp the Red Pocket against your relatives in a courtesy manner?
- Multiple friends to date with
You are not alone, after all you need a social life. Choose and date with 14 friends in total with various interaction in order to know them better. Who knows what post-graduation fairy tales will happen to these childhood sweethearts?
-Over 100 career endings
Persuade your dream career, and choose your own life. Will you settle to be an average nobody, or only after reaching the top of everything will your ambition be properly answered?
-Your family journeys on, from generation to generation
Your child in the next game will benefit from your achievements in the previous generation. Don’t forget to check back your roots to find courage and wits for the future.

bluejetty:00026654:ios.description:
Watch Duty is the only disaster mapping and alert app powered by real people giving you real-time information on wildfires and floods vetted by trained professionals, not robots or AI. While many other apps rely solely on government alerts, which can often be delayed, Watch Duty provides up-to-the-minute, life-saving information through a dedicated team of active and retired firefighters, dispatchers, first responders, and reporters who monitor radio scanners around the clock. We aim to keep you informed and safe with real-time updates and alerts.
Disaster Tracking Features:
- Push notifications about nearby safety impacting floods, wildfires, and firefighting or emergency response efforts
- Real-time updates as conditions change
- Evacuation orders & shelter information
- Active fire perimeters and progress
- Flash flood warnings and threat levels
- Current and projected river gauge flooding levels
- Infrared satellite hotspots from VIIRS and MODIS
- Wind speed and direction
- Power outage size and estimated resolution time
- Historical wildfire perimeters
- Air quality readings
- Street and satellite maps
- Air attack and air tanker flight tracker
- Save locations for quick access on the map
Watch Duty is a 501(c)(3) non-profit organization. Our service will always remain free of charge and free of ads. You can support our mission with a $25/year membership, which grants access to special features as a token of our appreciation.
Disclaimer: Watch Duty is not affiliated with any government agency. The information provided in this app is sourced from publicly available and trusted sources, including but not limited to government agencies, radio transmissions, and satellite data. Specific government sources include:
- National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration: https://www.noaa.gov/
- VIIRS: https://www.earthdata.nasa.gov/data/instruments/viirs
- MODIS: https://modis.gsfc.nasa.gov
- National Interagency Fire Center (NIFC): https://www.nifc.gov
- California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection (CAL FIRE): https://www.fire.ca.gov
- California Governor's Office of Emergency Services (Cal OES): https://www.caloes.ca.gov
- National Weather Service (NWS): https://www.weather.gov/
- Environmental Protection Agency (EPA): https://www.epa.gov/
- Bureau of Land Management: https://www.blm.gov/
- Department of Defense: https://www.defense.gov/
- National Park Service: https://www.nps.gov/
- US Fish and Wildlife Service: https://www.fws.gov/
- US Forest Service: https://www.fs.usda.gov/
For more information or support, feel free to contact us at support.watchduty.org.
Privacy Policy: https://www.watchduty.org/legal/privacy-policy

The best Mahjong on the app store!
Simple, modern, and with unlimited puzzles.
If you love matching games, Solitaire, or other single-player card games, then Mahjong Match is for you!

- Highlight valid moves or turn this option off for a real challenge!
- Fully customizable with three different tile sets and hundreds of background combinations. More tilesets to come!

- Match same symbol tiles that are not covered by another tile or blocked.
- Blocked tiles are tiles that have another tile on the left or right side.
- Match all of the tiles to clear the board!

Extreme Car: Stunt Car Games is a continuation of the Stunt Car Racing Challenge car game series.

bluejetty:00016047:ios.name: Big Farm: Mobile Harvest
bluejetty:00016047:ios.summary:
Big Farm: Mobile Harvest is a free farm simulator game that you can play online with friends, family, and farmers around the world. Build your own community and have fun creating the farm life of your dreams.
*Farm with friends: Big Farm:
bluejetty:00016047:ios.description:
Big Farm: Mobile Harvest is a free farm simulator game that you can play online with friends, family, and farmers around the world. Build your own community and have fun creating the farm life of your dreams.
*Farm with friends: Big Farm: Mobile Harvest is a free farming simulator online game that lets you join up with your friends and create a beautiful farm village of your very own.
*Farming simulator experience: Build your farm and plant, grow and harvest your favorite fruits and vegetables.
*All done with your farm chores? Time to look after your animal friends: A good farmer keeps their four-legged friends happy. Have fun caring for cows, goats, chickens, horses, pigs, and many other cuddly companions.
*Farm, harvest, and trade: Did you harvest extra corn but need some strawberries? In the market, you can make trades to help your farming village prosper.
*More than a farming simulator game - it's a community: Meet, chat, discuss, and complete joint quests with farmers worldwide.
*Build the number one farm: Starting with nothing but raw seeds, you'll use all your farming skills to grow your crops until they're ready to be sold at the market.
*Farm your way: Grow hay on your farm. Harvest organic foods and farm-fresh goods, all from your farm village.
*Build your dream farm: Add vintage buildings, windmills, and decorations to create the farm of your dreams.
*Plenty of options: Choose what you want to grow! From tropical fruits to organic vegetables, your farm village is sure to set new trends in the market.
*Manage your farm village: Distribute your crops after each planting cycle, sow seeds, water your plants, feed your animals, make clever deals in the farm marketplace, and collect rewards.
*Farming adventures: Participate in events and farming quests to find missing items that will improve your farm.
*Relax on your farm: Escape the hustle and bustle of the city and enjoy life on your very own farm! Take a break and enjoy some sun and relaxation.
*Farming with your family: Invite your family and enjoy farming together in the peaceful countryside.
*Learn from farmers worldwide: Join the Big Farm community and meet farmers from all over the world. Learn about their farming methods to keep your farm village prosperous.
Big Farm: Mobile Harvest game is completely free to play with optional in-app purchases. You may disable in-app purchasing using your device settings. This game requires an internet connection. Privacy Policy, Terms & Conditions, Imprint: https://policies.altigi.de/

bluejetty:00034065:ios.description:
AirDroid Kids is the companion app of the AirDroid Parental Control App. Parents can make sure that their children are all safe while children can enjoy their latest iPhones and iPads in a safe and secure environment.
Please only install AirDroid Kids onto to a device being used by your child or teen. Using AirDroid Parental Control, children can communicate and tell their parents instantly if they get into trouble.
How to get started
1. Download the AirDroid Parental Control App onto your device 
2. Then download the AirDroid Kids App onto any of your child’s devices you want to monitor. 
3. After you finish, the two apps allow you to seamlessly manage your child’s daily on linked mobile or desktop devices.
Discover the new Family Chatting: Instantly connect with your loved ones and stay connected with a single tap.
More Features include:
• Website and app usage monitoring on the child’s device
• Website blocking and category blocking (block games, porn, gambling, and lockout unwanted content) on the child’s device
• Location tracking of the child's device
• Safe search and custom black & white list on the child’s device
• Real-time alerts sent to parents
• Check route history & geofence alert
• Daily Downtime for specific Apps & Websites
• Apps & Websites limit set by the Parent App
• Install and Uninstall Restriction & Anti-bait and Switch
If you have any questions or need help, contact us at support@airdroid.com
We take privacy and the protection of your family and children’s data extremely seriously. We do not and will not sell data to third parties. Your child’s screen time activity is for your eyes only.
Terms of Service: https://ios.airdroidkids.com/#/Terms
Important notes for users
- The AirDroid Kids App for iOS install process will ask you to install a special MDM profile and accept special permissions to control the internet traffic on the device. This profile can be removed or disabled by you whenever you want. Instructions for installing, uninstalling, and configuring are on our help page.

With the Gmail ap
bluejetty:00019540:ios.description:
The official Gmail app brings the best of Gmail to your iPhone and iPad with helpful AI features, robust security, real-time notifications, multiple account support, and intelligent search that works across all your mail.
With the Gmail app, you can:
• Make Gmail your default email app on iOS
• Stay up to date on your latest packages, upcoming events, bills, and travel details with helpful summary cards
• Declutter your inbox with built-in email subscription management
• Use Gemini* in Gmail to summarize lengthy emails, craft or refine responses, or search your inbox to find what you’re looking for
• Connect and switch between multiple email accounts from different providers
• Automatically block more than 99.9% of spam, phishing, malware from ever reaching your inbox
• Quickly add events to Google Calendar based on your emails with Gemini in Gmail
• Find top deals faster with a personalized Promotions tab
• Respond to emails faster with AI-powered Suggested Replies that understand the context of your emails and match your unique tone and style
• Undo send for up to 30 seconds, to prevent embarrassing mistakes
• Access Google Meet and Google Chat without leaving Gmail
• Organize your mail by labeling, starring, deleting, and reporting spam
• Swipe to archive/delete, to quickly clear out your inbox
Gmail is part of Google Workspace, allowing you and your team to easily connect, create, and collaborate. You can:
• Connect with coworkers via Google Meet or Google Chat, send an invite in Google Calendar, add an action to your task list, and more without leaving Gmail
• Use Gemini in Gmail features like Help me write, Suggested Replies, AI Overviews, and Proofread to help you stay on top of work and take care of simple tasks, so you can be more efficient with your time
• Stay safe. Our machine learning models block more than 99.9% of spam, phishing, and malware from reaching our users
*Some Gemini features may require a Google One AI subscription. Internet connection required. Language and country availability may vary. Check responses for accuracy.

bluejetty:00018419:ios.description:
Conheça a nova experiência do TradeMap: um app que traduz o mundo dos investimentos em algo intuitivo e acessível :)
É o TradeMap que você já conhece, mas agora com uma proposta visual mais moderna, navegação fluida, nova usabilidade e ainda mais recursos para você poder explorar o mercado financeiro.
Uma plataforma feita para todos! E que veio para facilitar o acesso e entendimento de funções do mercado, estimular a troca de conhecimentos e, principalmente, inovar na sua experiência com ferramentas para você tomar as melhores decisões de investimentos.
Baixe agora! E conte com:
- As notícias mais quentes que movimentam as bolsas do Brasil e dos EUA
- Integração e acompanhamento da sua Carteira Consolidada com gráfico em tempo real
- Envio de ordens diretamente pelo App ao conectar sua conta com uma de nossas corretoras parceiras: XP Investimentos, Guide, BTG Pactual, Warren, MyCAP, Genial, Nova Futura, Mirae, Terra, NovaDAX, Foxbit, Binance, Coinext, Mercado Bitcoin e muito mais! 
- Detalhes dos seus investimentos: Desempenho, Estatísticas e Risco
- Consultas e criação de listas (Ações, Stocks, BDRs, Criptos, Índices e muito mais)
- Detalhamento de cada ativo, incluindo os prós e contras de cada um e as recomendações de bancos e corretoras
Acha que parou por aí? Não mesmo, né? Além dos já conhecidos e consagrados módulos do TradeMap, a nova experiência vem com novas funções disruptivas para você! Se liga:
- Carteira, P&L e comparações intraday – em tempo real mesmo!
- Cardápio e sugestões de ativos
- Curadoria e humanização na análise de destaques de empresas brasileiras e Fundos Imobiliários
Além de tudo isso, contamos com um ecossistema completo de mercado. Veja só:
- EducaMap: a maior vitrine de cursos gratuitos de investimentos
- Ligas de competição em ambiente simulado: aprenda a investir com dinheiro fictício (e valendo prêmios)
- Ideias e conteúdos compartilhados por usuários: interaja com a Comunidade TradeMap
- Chat para conversas entre amigos e recebimento de notificações de empresas e investimentos!
Baixe agora e faça parte dessa experiência1

bluejetty:00016198:ios.description:
ClipSpeed, increase or decrease video speed easily on your device. If you are looking for an app to make your video in slow motion or to make your video in fast motion, then download our ClipSpeed app to your iOS device. In this app you can also add background audio to your video clip. This app is exclusively designed to do only two task- to slow video and to fasten your video. 
If you are researching for what is the best slow motion app? then why don’t to try this app once? with our clipspeed app you can easily adjust the speed of the video without bothering much settings.
Key Features of ClipSpeed app :
1. ClipSpeed app is exclusively designed to make slow motion video or fast motion video easily
2. Simple user interface
3. You can select the particular region of video clip to increase or decrease video speed
4. Add music to your video
4. Save to camera roll, upload to instagram, mail, upload to youtube, upload to viddy option are provided in the app itself. 
Steps to Slow down video or speed up video with ClipSpeed App:
1. Select the video clip that you want to increase or decrease video speed.
2. In the next screen you will be in “Adjust Speed” screen. Here you can increase or decrease the speed of the video. By default our clip speed app will select complete video, but you can choose only particular portion of that video by using selecting scroll bar at the bottom of Adjust speed window. Once you select the particular video position that you want to increase or decrease the video speed, next you decide whether you need to make slow motion video or fast motion video of the selected video clip. 
If you wish to make Fast Motion video, then drag the Video Speed controlling slider towards right side, if you wish to slow down the video then drag the video speed controller slider towards left side. Once you done that just click on the Right mark icon on the top right corner to generate new video clip. Once you done generating video you can save that generated video clip to your Camera roll, upload to instagram, you can mail that clip, upload to youtube or share it on viddy with our built-in social sharing option. 
3. If you wish to add music to your video then click on Music icon on Adjust speed screen and choose the audio file that you need to add to your video
If you are searching for slow motion video app or fast motion video app then download our ClipSpeed app to your device.

bluejetty:00024326:ios.description:
Toolbox 2.0 provides Battery Service Technicians with the most up-to-date database of battery fitment information and specific installation requirements, along with new key features for improved roadside performance to elevate the customer experience. Technicians will quickly resolve a vehicle battery event by accurately identifying the correct battery fitment, specific installation requirements, and accurate billing for services provided.
NEW TO TOOLBOX 2.0: VIN Scanning/Decoding (reduces time on scene/increases accuracy of fitment info); Multilingual Support (English, Spanish, French-Canadian); Better Search Options (select Year-first or Make-first searching); Vehicle specific battery location diagrams; Regional pricing support (only for AAA/CAA).
Toolbox 2.0 also provides just-in-time training support at the Technician’s fingertips with access to quality training content from Club Assist: a video training library, downloadable quick reference guides, job aids, and more!

bluejetty:00024833:ios.summary: Physics game lovers enjoy this new puzzle game in which they draw a safe path for the zip line and avoid the dangers. The mission is to move people cabin to cabin safely. Many dangers and traps are waiting for you on this rope road but if y
bluejetty:00024833:ios.description:
Physics game lovers enjoy this new puzzle game in which they draw a safe path for the zip line and avoid the dangers. The mission is to move people cabin to cabin safely. Many dangers and traps are waiting for you on this rope road but if you think strategically and connect the two homes with a safe zip line, passengers will arrive their destination alive.
To rescue the friends waiting at the starting point of this dangerous valley, draw a line with your fingers and after reaching the other home, tap on the screen to let the passengers go on the zip line. How long you hold your finger on the screen, the more passengers do zip line. To avoid the dangers, you can draw the line around the blocks, you can move the line just like a rope. The game mechanic is based on whipping a rope.
There are many hazards and traps to challenge, so this brain training physics puzzle game won't let you get bored. Minimalist and unique design and tons of free puzzle levels keep you entertained for hours. As drawing the line, take the coins and keys into consideration. To collect coins and keys bring some gifts to you.

bluejetty:00035812:ios.description:
Expert restaurant recommendations for every situation.
Our mission is very simple: to bring you the most honest and trustworthy opinions on where to eat around the world. Find a restaurant that’s “Perfect For” every situation. Search restaurant recommendations in our curated guides & reviews, or via map & list views, in over 40 different cities.
Coverage in: New York, London, Los Angeles, Chicago, San Francisco, Boston, Philadelphia, Seattle, Washington DC, Atlanta, Austin, Denver, Paris, Mexico City, Melbourne, Rome, and Tokyo, and beyond with more on the way.
FEATURES:
Find Places: Search for nearby restaurants based on your current location, or browse for a spot in a city you are planning to visit. Filter on specific cuisines types, or “Perfect Fors” to find the right restaurant for every situation.
Explore: Browse our restaurant reviews and curated guides in more than 40 cities worldwide. Use different categories to find the restaurant that best suits your needs. Categories include: Perfect Fors (Ex: Girls' Night Out, Late Night Eats), Cuisine, and Neighborhood.
My Infatuation: Create an account with The Infatuation to save your favorite reviews and curate your own list.
“Apps for finding restaurants are plentiful, but most of them leave me feeling overwhelmed. I want someone to choose for me, and I trust the authors of this app to do that. Their taste has never led me astray.” - Joshua Brustein, The New York Times
In 2021, restaurant discovery platform The Infatuation was acquired by JPMorgan Chase & Co. to accelerate the firm’s investment in dining, and further demonstrates JPMorgan Chase’s commitment to meeting customers where they are with exceptional benefits, useful content and one-of-a-kind experiences, at scale. The Infatuation’s entire business, including Zagat, is a wholly owned subsidiary of JPMorgan Chase.

bluejetty:00016303:ios.name: DomiNations
bluejetty:00016303:ios.summary: Wage war and battle for total world domination in DomiNations. Enter an age of empires as you travel through different eras of history. From the beginnings of the world to the modern age, you’ll need to fight for dominance and secure your e
bluejetty:00016303:ios.description:
Wage war and battle for total world domination in DomiNations. Enter an age of empires as you travel through different eras of history. From the beginnings of the world to the modern age, you’ll need to fight for dominance and secure your empire’s safety. Bring your army to life in real-time strategy games that pit you against your foes across every age of history.
Empires begin as an early settlement that grows through the ages, from the dawn of history to the modern era. Develop, craft and master strategies at the University. Study under history’s greats or explore the new University Hall to enhance your approach to world domination. Build Wonders of the World and dominate battles with high-tech fighter jets from the modern era. Build your base and strengthen your defenses with the Council with new Councilors and Artifacts to give your army the edge in battle.
Build your base, grow your army, and test your strategy against other players in PvP combat. Conquer the globe in World War and take home the spoils of war in DomiNations.
REAL TIME STRATEGY GAMES INTERTWINED WITH WORLD HISTORY
• Strategy games with fun limited-time goals based on actual events from history.
• Collect rare rewards to help your Nation advance so they can conquer the world!
• Upgrade your base and your army with every age.
• Work alongside leaders like Leonardo Da Vinci, Cleopatra, King Sejong, and more.
BUILD AN EMPIRE & LEAD AN ARMY
• Build a base, starting with a small civilization and grow it into a thriving metropolis.
• Expand your kingdom and defend your nation in the age of war.
• Choose one of the great civilizations from history like the Romans, British, Chinese, French, Germans, Japanese, Koreans and Greeks.
• Build historic Wonders of the World, including landmarks like the Pyramids of Egypt and the Roman Colosseum.
• Upgrade your base as you advance through history, tackling historic battle campaigns to collect important resources.
• Resource management through the mechanics of war. Lead your army through battles for untold wealth and total world domination.
WAR SIMULATION GAMES: BATTLE THROUGH THE ERAS
• Simulation games allow you to build an army and lead a colony of early hunters and gatherers on their conquest through the ages from the dawn of civilization to the modern era.
• Conquer the world as one of 8 fearsome Nations on its journey through time.
• Battle your enemies and take over cities for huge bunches of loot!
DISCOVER NEW TECHNOLOGIES
• Research civilizations, new materials, invent advanced weaponry and develop trade to grow a bustling economy.
• Level up through scientific discovery.
• Reinforce your troops with better equipment, upgrade your buildings and town center with modern materials.
• The path to victory is your own. Collect special cosmetic weaponry, armor and color schemes to customize your own Commanders, with a brand new customization system. Showcase your style and strike fear in your enemies.
PVP BATTLES IN STRATEGIC WAR GAMES
• PVP combat awaits. Take on foes one-on-one in battles for greatness.
• Multiplayer war allows you to team up with other skilled rulers and forge an Alliance.
• Unleash your unique battle strategy to outwit and outlast your opponents in 50-on-50 Alliance warfare.
• Resource management through the mechanics of war. Battle for untold wealth and total world domination.
Application Permission Usage Notice:
We request access permissions to provide services as below
• Device ID & phone calls: Identifies the relationship between device & base
• Read, write on external storage: Capturing screenshots shared with customer service team
Privacy Policy:
https://bighugegames.com/privacy-policy/

https://bighugegames.com/terms-of-use/a
