bluejetty:00016968:ios.description:
The App Store’s top Texas Hold’em odds/equity calculator.
(The *Advanced* version of PokerCruncher.)
Take your game to the next level with PokerCruncher, an advanced professional-level hand ranges and flop texture analysis Texas Hold’em odds/equity calculator that goes well beyond the standard features.
*** Pay once and enjoy forever ***
No in-app purchases/fees.
Continual improvement for many years.
*** Tutorial and videos on our website ***
***
New: Links to videos and blogs on PokerCruncher (by pros/coaches) directly inside the app.
***
"... incredibly powerful tool ... must-have application."
 -- PokerSoftware.com
"... essentially functions as an advanced version of the PC’s PokerStove application."
 -- Bluff Magazine
Great reviews from poker experts, pros, and coaches, and on our TwoPlusTwo forum thread.
(See our website.)
--> Super fast and easy to use for basic hand matchups.
--> Advanced features like hand ranges, Deal-To-Flop, flop texture analysis, and many stats for serious strategy analysis.
--> Tutorial, videos.
Most poker odds/equity calc apps are nowhere as powerful as PokerCruncher. Some don’t even support random hands (let alone hand ranges), some don’t let you enter hands for multiple players, some make an incomplete attempt at hand ranges, …
PokerCruncher is the full real deal, and has a clean and easy-to-use interface.
Start using PokerCruncher today to improve your game and your results!
***
iPhone, iPad, and Mac(Expert) versions available
***
--- Completely General ---
Up to 10 players, with specific cards, random/unknown cards, or hand ranges for each player. Dead cards, %age’s or n:1 odds, …
--- Fully General Hand Ranges ---
Poker is a game of incomplete information; we need to think in terms of *ranges of hands*. PokerCruncher surpasses the standard features, e.g. range equity breakdown heat maps and hand combo stats. Full grid of all 169 starting hands, top x% of hands slider, select hand combos (suits and weights) in hand ranges, extensive built-in hand ranges, save/load and export/import hand ranges, …
--- Deal-To-Flop and Flop Texture Analysis ---
--- Many Stats ---
Hand type stats (OnePair, TwoPair, etc.), flop hit stats, odds for flopping draws and combination draws, OnePair breakdown stats, …
---
Save/Load and Export/Import Scenarios (Hands) and Hand Ranges
---
---
Enter/Edit Scenario Notes
---
--- Tutorial and Videos ---
If thinking in terms of hand ranges and flop texture analysis (techniques advanced players and pros use) are new to you, no problem, see the PokerCruncher Tutorial and videos on our website.
***
See our website for our strong free app update history over many years.
***
GENERAL AND OTHER FEATURES:
+ Runs locally on device, internet connection not needed
+ Fast Monte Carlo simulation, complete enumeration for some common cases
+ Completely general tool, e.g. up to 10 players
+ Specific cards, random/unknown cards, fully general hand ranges, for each player
+ Generate random player and board cards to set up what-if and test scenarios
+ Dead cards
+ Fold/Un-Fold players
+ %age’s or n:1 odds
Please see the PokerCruncher Tutorial and videos on our website for more information.
App Store reviews are greatly appreciated, thank you.
***
Also please check out our companion app Tournament Cruncher (ICM).
***

bluejetty:00015827:ios.description:
** More than 10,000,000 musicians are now using the Tuner by Piascore! **
"Tuner by Piascore" is a chromatic instrument tuner and pitch pipe that allows you to quickly and accurately tune your instrument using the built-in mic in your iPhone or iPad.
"Tuner by Piascore" supports a custom temperaments, transposition, notations such as solfège, adjustable calibration and more. By spectrum power indicator, you can understand sound more intuitively. "Tuner by Piascore" packs more power than most pro tuners, yet it is simple enough for everyone to use.
"Tuner by Piascore" can tune acoustic or electric guitar, bass, bowed strings, woodwinds, brass, piano, tympani, and any other instrument that can sustain a tone.
Free version "Tuner Lite by Piascore" is offered.
** Features **
- Needle meter display
- Ultra responsive 50 cents range fine tuning display
- LED display easy-to-understand high and low sound
- Accuracy ±0.01 semitone (±1 cent)
- Landscape view (iPhone5 or later)
- Power spectrum indicator
- Selectable Temperaments
- Selectable Notations (such as Solfège)
- Support for transposing instruments
- Pitch Pipe/Tone generator
- Automatic reference note calibration
- Changing the wallpaper
** Contact **
: http://piascore.com/service/tuner/
: contact@piascore.com

bluejetty:00024401:ios.description:
Manage your stress with Stress Watch: Heart Rate Monitor!
Stress affects your mental and physical health. With Stress Watch app, you can monitor your stress levels, track your heart rate variability (HRV), and gain insights to improve your well-being. With cutting-edge technology and integration with Apple Health, it provides accurate insights and personalized support to help you stay balanced in your daily life.
How does it work?
Stress Watch integrates seamlessly with Apple Health to track your HRV, sleep, and activity data. All you need to do is sync the app with your Apple Watch or mobile device. It identifies your Stress Score by analyzing HRV data, demographic details like age and gender, and other key factors such as time of day. With just a few taps, you’ll have a clear view of your stress levels.
What are the features?
- Integrates with Apple Health to sync HRV, sleep, and activity data.
- Provides a personalized Stress Score based on your unique metrics.
- Real-time notifications and alerts when your stress levels are high.
- Historical data tracking with detailed visualizations and trends.
- Personalized onboarding to tailor the app to your needs.
- Option to unlock advanced features with a premium subscription.
Why this app is right for you:
- You want to monitor your stress and emotions.
- You need real-time alerts when stress levels rise.
- You’re looking for a comprehensive tool to track HRV, sleep, and activity.
- You want to visualize your stress trends and take proactive steps toward better health.
Your Health, Your Data
Stress Watch values your privacy. All data is securely handled and stored, ensuring you have full control over what is shared.
Take control of your stress and maintain inner balance with us — a solution designed to help you stay calm and in control.
In-app Subscriptions:
• Subscribed users have unlimited access to the sleep tracking features and sounds services.
• Unsubscribed users can only use those services with limited quota per day.
• Users can subscribe one week (USD 2.99$) or one month (USD 7.99$) auto renewing subscription.
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
• The account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.

For free, download the app, search for your meet, and review the meet program, which shows the meet location, a scheduled order of events, and the athlet
bluejetty:00021781:ios.description:
Track Meet Mobile is the must-have app for Track & Field athletes, coaches, and fans.
For free, download the app, search for your meet, and review the meet program, which shows the meet location, a scheduled order of events, and the athletes and teams who are competing.
Subscribe to unofficial meet results, including times, marks, order of finish, wind readings, field series, and more — available only at meets where meet hosts and officials support the publication of results to mobile with HY-TEK Track & Field Meet Manager 5.0.
Can’t find your meet?
Ask the meet host to update to version 5.0 of HY-TEK’s Track & Field Meet Manager, the most widely used Track & Field software in the world, and publish the meet information to Track Meet Mobile. 
HY-TEK encourages meet hosts and officials to publish meet programs and meet results for the meets you want, and in a timely and accurate way. More meets are being added every week. However, HY-TEK does not control and cannot guarantee the availability or accuracy of meet programs or meet results. Meet results availability is dependent on meet hosts publishing that data. Please check with the meet host before subscribing to make sure results are being published for your meet.
Key Features
• View results, anytime, anywhere*
• Quickly find track and field meets with robust search functions
• Track athletes and teams, even if you’re not at the meet 
• Flag your “Favorite” athletes and teams to find them easily
• View heat/flight results along with wind readings and field series*
• View overall athlete and relay rankings for each round of each event*
• Check team scores*
• View who advanced by place and who advanced by time*
• View relay member names for each relay*
• View up to the minute standings for Combined Events such as the Decathlon*
• For Veterans meets, age graded results are shown along with the actual result*
• View Cross Country finish order and team score rankings*
• View Field Event Relay rankings*
• View the complete roster of teams and athletes*
• Select an athlete and view all completed and upcoming events for the athlete*
• View improvement from round to round*
• View records and time/mark standards
• Share your event via email, messaging, Facebook or Twitter
Meet Hosts
• Offer results for all of your meets
• Push out the event schedule, performance sheet information, and team rosters prior to the meet
• Get exposure within the app when people search for criteria that match your meet
• Make fans, athletes and coaches happy by offering meet access from anywhere in the world, virtually in real time
• Let fans send your meet viral as they share their favorite athletes’ results instantly via Facebook, Twitter, email or text
*Meet Results
Meet results are available as an in-app subscription. This dynamic content is available where meet hosts and officials support the publication of results to mobile using version 5.0 of HY-TEK’s Track & Field MEET MANAGER - - the most widely-used track & field meet management software in the world.
Monthly subscriptions are offered at Apple Tier 9 pricing ($4.49 USD). Annual subscriptions are offered at Apple Tier 20 pricing ($9.99 USD).
Subscriptions are charged to your iTunes account when you confirm your purchase and will auto-renew at the end of the subscription period for the same price tier and duration as your initial enrollment, unless cancelled at least 24-hours before the end of your current subscription period. Cancellation or refund of the active current subscription period is not allowed per Apple’s policies. In the app, tap More to either Restore or Manage Your Subscription.
ACTIVE Network works hard to ensure your privacy and data security. Our policy can be found at:
http://www.activenetwork.com/information/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00000571:ios.summary:
Join over 170,000 avid players on the most loved bridge app in the world! Play online bridge, learn the game and progress at your own pace. With Funbridge, enjoy playing duplicate or multiplayer bridge anywhere, anytime!
Bridge is an excit
bluejetty:00000571:ios.description:
Join over 170,000 avid players on the most loved bridge app in the world! Play online bridge, learn the game and progress at your own pace. With Funbridge, enjoy playing duplicate or multiplayer bridge anywhere, anytime!
Bridge is an exciting card game played by four players in two teams of two called “partnerships”. The bridge partners sit opposite each other at a table. The game of bridge consists of a number of “deals” (also “boards” or “hands”) and involves two stages: there is an “auction” (also called “bidding”) to determine the contract to be made, and then the “card play” where you must reach the goal set.
On Funbridge, you play in South, whereas North, East and West are played by a specialized artificial intelligence, the same for all players. So, you don’t need to wait for other players to play bridge. The AI is available 24/7 to allow you to play bridge whenever you want.

bluejetty:00021287:ios.description:
End Self-Sabotage Hypnosis offers 98 guided hypnosis programs by Joel Thielke, C.Ht., for procrastination, self-doubt, confidence and the habits that hold you back.
START WITH STOP SELF-CRITICISM
Stop Self-Criticism, a gentle session on noticing the critical voice in your head and answering it with forgiveness, is included with the app: play it in full, with no purchase and no subscription. It is built into the app, so it plays without a connection. Then continue with End Sabotage, Joel's core program on noticing where you get in your own way, which also plays offline.
BREAK FREE FIRST
The library opens on Break Free: fifteen programs including End Sabotage, Get Out Of Your Way, Stop Procrastinating, Stop Being A Victim, Let Go Of The Past and The Power of Saying No. Six more shelves cover confidence and esteem, motivation and focus, calm and relief, relationships, health and habits, and inner growth. Search by everyday words, such as "putting things off" or "self-doubt".
SHAPE EACH SESSION
Choose a program, then one of six inductions, classic and new: the original Short, Long and Sleep, plus Beach (a calm walk along the shore), Speed (a fast way in) and Staircase (counting down step by step). Then pick an ending: Wake, Sleep, None or Delay. Line programs up in a playlist, repeat them for as long as you like, and set a sleep timer. Playback continues with the screen locked, with lock-screen controls. On iPhone Duo the app fits both the outer and the inner display, and Nightstand mode turns the player into a calm bedside view when you stand the phone half-open. Other programs stream the first time and are kept on your device after that.
A SOUND BENEATH THE VOICE
One background sound is included with every session. The separately purchased Sound Mixer layers up to four of 15 sounds, such as rain, ocean, campfire and wind, with your own levels and saved mixes.
ONE-TIME PURCHASES
Buy single programs, including End Sabotage, or unlock every program with one payment. Unlock All covers the program library and is available through Family Sharing; the Sound Mixer is sold separately. Every purchase is one-time and restorable. There is no subscription. If you had the app before version 4.1, End Sabotage stays yours. Programs you bought before are still yours: tap Restore Purchases in Settings.
ABOUT JOEL THIELKE
Joel Thielke is a Certified Clinical Hypnotherapist who has created guided hypnosis programs for more than two decades. Questions? Write to support@motivationalhypnotherapy.com from Settings.

bluejetty:00022572:ios.summary:
Word Scenery Master is an app designed to train your brain and learn new words all while having a great time. Share the fun with your family & friends and enjoy Word Scenery together!
Enjoy modern word puzzles with the best of word searchi
bluejetty:00022572:ios.description:
Word Scenery Master is an app designed to train your brain and learn new words all while having a great time. Share the fun with your family & friends and enjoy Word Scenery together!
Enjoy modern word puzzles with the best of word searching, anagrams, and crosswords! Immerse yourself into the beautiful scenery backgrounds to relax and ease your mind.
It’s simple, beautiful, and marvelously fun to play.Be warned, it’s absolutely addicting.
Playing Word Scenery 10 mins a day sharpens your mind and prepares you for your daily life and challenges!
Challenge yourself to connect letters and find as many hidden words as you can! Unlock stunning landscape backgrounds to escape from home and relax your brain.
Exercise your brain and with thousands of challenging word puzzles,Test your word smarts, unlock new levels and climb the vocabulary ladder.
• Relax your brain by visiting the beautiful destinations of Word Scenery!
• Show your vocabulary power by connecting letters and finding all the hidden words.
• Get your word hunt on with over 6,000 crossword puzzles!
• Challenge your brain and vocabulary – this crossword puzzle starts easy and progressively become more challenging!
• Think you can beat these anagram word puzzles? They start simply but ramp up fast!
• Take each level at your own pace with unlimited tries. Simply fun and relaxation!
• If you find yourself stuck, use letter hints and the word shuffle to guide your way!
• Offline Mode! No wifi? Don’t worry, you can play Word Scenery anytime, anywhere even without a network connection!
• Multiple Choices! Supported on iPhone, iPad.
It's a perfect fit for fans of crossword, word connect and word anagram games, combining best of word find games and crossword puzzles. Not to mention all the gorgeous landscapes you can visit to relax yourself!
Contact Us:
• zneil@126.com

bluejetty:00023905:ios.name: Pentix Nova - Falling Blocks
bluejetty:00023905:ios.summary: Reimagination and a remake of the immortal classic. Arrange the falling pieces to fill up and clear the lines. Clear as many lines as possible to advance through levels or complete various objectives. This game is inspired by the four brick
bluejetty:00023905:ios.description:
Reimagination and a remake of the immortal classic. Arrange the falling pieces to fill up and clear the lines. Clear as many lines as possible to advance through levels or complete various objectives. This game is inspired by the four brick falling blocks games. But instead of easy four brick pieces, where the name Tetra comes from, this game uses five bricks pieces, thus the name Penta. Of course, you are not limited to either set of pieces. Play any combination you would like and consider more fun.
Fun question: Do you see the black dots when you are looking at the game title screen? Do you think they are there?
Features:
- Play an endless game or complete objectives.
- Play individual levels or progress through the campaign.
- Smooth and customizable controls.
- Various difficulty levels.
Controls:
The controls were designed to make the gameplay smooth and enjoyable. Below are the few highlights that make this game stand out.
- Tap with the second finger or swipe down to drop the piece. Of course, you can use the "Drop" buttons too.
- Swipe up to stash the piece and use it later in the game. This allows for more strategic play.
Privacy policy: https://akatek.biz/apps/pentix_nova/privacy_policy
Terms of Service: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula

bluejetty:00021480:ios.name: Global Smart Plus
bluejetty:00021480:ios.summary: Experience next-generation digital banking with Global Smart Plus, the all-in-one banking platform from Global IME Bank. Designed with a seamless omni-channel experience and single sign-on access, Global Smart Plus allows you to use the sam
bluejetty:00021480:ios.description:
Experience next-generation digital banking with Global Smart Plus, the all-in-one banking platform from Global IME Bank. Designed with a seamless omni-channel experience and single sign-on access, Global Smart Plus allows you to use the same login credentials across platforms for secure and convenient banking anytime, anywhere.
From opening a bank account instantly to making QR payments, paying utility bills, managing cards, investing in shares, and tracking your expenses, Global Smart Plus brings all your everyday banking and financial needs into one secure and smart platform. With built-in personal financial management tools, digital services, and real-time access to your finances, banking has never been easier, faster, or smarter.
Why Choose Global Smart Plus?
Quick Account Opening:
Experience seamless onboarding. You can open a bank account from the app using highly secure AI powered 3D facial authentication and start transacting within few minutes.
Personal Financial Management:
See where your money goes with Budget360°. Track daily expenses, set savings goals, use round up savings, set budget and split bills when needed.
Share Market:
Stay ahead in the market. Access real-time NEPSE data, apply for IPOs instantly, manage your portfolio, and find investment opportunities. Global Smart Plus includes live market tracking, share calculator, stock screeners, and fundamental/technical analysis tools to help make informed decisions.
Global Junior Account Open
Introduce children to smart banking from an early age with the Global Junior App, a companion app of Global Smart Plus. Parents can manage and monitor their child’s financial activities, encourage saving habits, and help them learn responsible money management in a safe and guided way.
QR Payment:
Scan ANY payment QR with Global Smart Plus. Payments can be made effortlessly across FonePay, NepalPay and SCT network.
Complete Card Management:
Manage your debit, credit cards, travel card, ecom card and more with Global Smart Plus. Link your cards, make real-time credit card payments, view CVV and detailed card information, and access transaction history anytime. The app also lets you block/unblock cards, request Green PIN, download credit card statements, view card limits, reset PIN count, and enjoy many more secure self-service features. Experience convenient and secure card management directly from your mobile.
Digital Loan:
Apply for Remit Karja or a loan against your fixed deposit straight from the app. No paperwork.
Utility & Bills Payment:
Pay for your internet, airlines, electricity, and water bills, or manage EMIs and Top-ups. Everything is simplified in one app.
Government Payments:
Skip the queues! Easily pay SSF, Traffic Fines, EPS, Health Insurance Board, NOC, OCR, and over 28+ other government payments.
Merchant Payments:
Make seamless payments to merchants, schools, vendors, and manage your EMIs effortlessly.
Cable Car Ticket Booking Made Easy:
Book cable car tickets easily with Global Smart Plus app. You can purchase tickets for popular cable cars like Chandragiri, Manakamana, Maulakalika, Lumbini, Annapurna, and more in just a few taps. The app offers a secure and hassle-free digital payment experience, helping you avoid long queues at ticket counters. Plan your travel conveniently and enjoy a smooth journey to your favorite destinations.
International Airlines
Book international airline tickets directly from the app. Whether you are travelling for business, study, or leisure, Global Smart Plus helps you manage your flight booking and payment in one secure platform.
Download Global Smart Plus and start your banking journey.

bluejetty:00016135:ios.name: Car Crash Simulator Royale
bluejetty:00016135:ios.summary: Crash and wreck all the cars! Drive fast to survive! Do maximum crash damage possible, earn cash and unlock crazy stuff like monster trucks and tanks. Sounds fun? Try the Car Crash & Demolition Derby Simulator and see how you like making ex
bluejetty:00016135:ios.description:
Crash and wreck all the cars! Drive fast to survive! Do maximum crash damage possible, earn cash and unlock crazy stuff like monster trucks and tanks. Sounds fun? Try the Car Crash & Demolition Derby Simulator and see how you like making extreme destruction in exciting little car derby wars. It's a game that is a mix of crash simulator style engine, fast paced action, demolition derby and car war games - yet quite unique by itself. 
Don't EVER even think about doing this in real life. Download this simulator game instead :)
Some of the awesome features of this game:
- Explore many crash simulator modes, including tank and mech
- Intense high speed crashing action
- Real-time car destruction and damage deformation + crash physics engine
- Choose between many high end cars
- Customize and improve your car by upgrades and tuning
- Incredible visuals and great performance on a wide range of devices
- Realistic car wreckage and debris simulation
Have fun smashing and destroying your adversaries, but keep in mind please that the game is a very fun simulation of the real thing. However, in this derby simulator limiting car damage is key to becoming victorious and how you smash into other cars makes a big difference. Always try to smash rivals when you have enough health or they are already damaged. A reckless head-on collisions with powerful cars should be avoided to prevent your engine to die or other extreme damage to occur. To boost the damage you inflict on an rival you can get your motor rev up and drive & crash faster by using the nitro boost. 
The game allows you to choose from various cars (including monster truck and other big vehicles). These all have the pros and cons. Be sure to buy upgrades wisely as the various type of modes require different cars. Use armor upgrades to strengthen your endurance; or engine upgrades to boost your speed, push and pulling power. Good results let you earn more money (cash) during races!
Car physics is realistic enough to ensure that simulation of crashes and destruction is done really nice - you can damage car slightly or a lot, and make its part fall off and fly around if you bump the car hard enough. 
You have 20+ cars to play with and 10+ maps to battle on, so enjoy demolition wars and good luck!

Vrbo is a vacation rental app for booking top-rated homes—beach houses, cabins, condos, cottages, and villas—so your family or group gets the entire place to yourselves. Members save 10% or more on select stays with Member Prices* and earn rewards** for future trips. Find the right place for your trip and book with confidence.
WHY TRAVELERS CHOOSE VRBO
- Top-rated homes with reviews from real guests, and space for everyone
- Plan together with Trip Planner and group chat, made for groups and families
- Deals and discounts: long-stay discounts and last-minute weekend deals
- Reserve now, pay later on eligible stays, with $0 due today***
- Book with confidence: over 2 million properties in 190+ countries, free cancellation on many reservations, VrboCare™ protection, and 24/7 support
MEMBER PRICES & REWARDS
- Members save 10% or more on select stays—sign in to see Member Prices
- Earn and use OneKeyCash on eligible bookings, and put your rewards toward a future getaway
- One Key™: a rewards program you won't find on any other vacation rental platform
RESERVE NOW, PAY LATER
- Lock in the home you love today, and pay closer to your trip
- See your payment date when you book, with a reminder before you're charged
TOP-RATED HOMES & STAYS
- Browse highly-rated places with reviews from real guests
- Clear photos, amenities, and details on every listing
- Find unique homes not listed on other platforms
GREAT FOR GROUPS & FAMILIES
- Choose a place with enough room for everyone
- Filter by price, location, and amenities—pools, backyards, pet-friendly homes, and beachfront stays
- Compare prices across multiple dates, or search within days, weeks, or a range of months
PLAN & TRAVEL TOGETHER
- Plan and collaborate with your group using Trip Planner and group chat, in real time from anywhere
- Invite friends and family to join your Trip Planner, leave comments, and vote for your favorite places
- Tap the heart icon to save and compare your favorite rentals

apple-macos:6757088514.name: Away Message: Status Sharing
apple-macos:6757088514.description:
Away Message is a status app that lets you tell friends where you are, what you’re doing, or when you’ll be back. It’s meant for quick, low-effort updates that keep people in the loop without turning into full conversations.
If you’re stepping out for coffee, going out for the night, or focusing on work, you can post a short note so your friends have context. You can attach a location, a photo, or a song you’re listening to. There are no likes, comments, or feeds to manage. The point is simply to share what’s going on.
Each status lasts from 30 minutes to 24 hours and then disappears. You can change the look of your updates with different fonts, colors, themes, and layouts. You can also add photos, drop a pin, or share music from Apple Music. Friends can drop an emoji on your status cards.
People connect through simple 6-character codes. You approve who joins your circle and control who can see your updates.
Features:
• Statuses that expire after 30 minutes to 24 hours
• Custom fonts, colors, themes, and layouts
• Photos, locations, and Apple Music sharing
• Scrapbook-style design for your notes
• Private connections using shareable codes
• No ads or algorithmic feeds
Away Message is for friends, coworkers, and small groups who want to stay aware of each other’s day without constantly messaging. You leave a note, and people see it when they check. Sometimes a quick “brb” really is all that’s needed.
